question: Should ClawRouter core own a default-off fusion virtual model plus bundled local OpenAI-compatible provider once the readiness, pricing, and proof blockers are fixed?
rationale: The PR adds new model-routing behavior, admin configuration, and provider-access semantics rather than only repairing existing behavior, so implementation review cannot settle whether this belongs in core.

options.title: Sponsor core fusion after repair
options.body: Accept the core direction only after the readiness gate, dynamic pricing, rebase, and real-behavior proof are fixed.

options.title: Narrow the landing scope
options.body: Ask for a smaller PR that lands only the local OpenAI-compatible provider or only the routing primitive before a full fusion product surface.

options.title: Pause outside core
options.body: Keep the ensemble-router idea out of core until maintainers define a plugin or external-provider boundary for it.

recommendation.title: Sponsor core fusion after repair
recommendation.body: Accept the core direction only after the readiness gate, dynamic pricing, rebase, and real-behavior proof are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: The current main history points to steipete as the strongest owner for the Worker routing, provider readiness, and admin-console surfaces involved.
